## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant regression tests added or existing coverage identified.
- [ ] Required CI checks pass on the current PR head.
- [ ] Packaging/install/update impact assessed where applicable.
- [ ] Hardware/UI behavior verified where relevant, or limitations stated.
- [ ] Security, dependency and compatibility impacts reviewed.

## Security evidence (required)

- Trust boundaries and changed attack surface:
- Negative/security regression tests and results (exact commit):
- New or changed dependencies, provenance and licences:
- Scanner findings, remediation or owner-approved expiring exceptions:
- Independent review evidence (AI/tool review does not count as human approval):
- Sensitive data/external service impact (none, or explicit authorized scope):

## Owner review

- [ ] Ready for owner review; remaining risks and rollback approach documented.

Do not enable auto-merge or merge on behalf of the owner. A checked box is not an approval or a substitute for GitHub branch protection.
